content: So this term, we're doing the book on marketing. Any business in a marketplace is likely to be in competition with other firms offering similar products.

You can't write everything down. You need to take notes. Well, just use a pen and a notebook.

What should I do if I missed something?
Hum... Just leave a blank in your notes and get the information from me later. Does that help?
Remember to read through your notes after the lecture.
So that's all for today. I had gotten advertising class to go to. We can discuss this further interactivity class.
